groups.title: Quality & organisational standards
groups.description: Independent standards that reflect how KBC operates as an organisation, employer and provider of guidance.

groups.title: Professional relationships & approved status
groups.description: Recognised relationships and approved status with professional bodies, held within their confirmed scope.

groups.title: Awards & external recognition
groups.description: External recognition of the quality and outcomes of KBC's professional provision.

recognitions.title: Matrix Standard
recognitions.description: The Matrix Standard is the national quality standard for information, advice and guidance. It independently assesses the quality of the information, advice and guidance KBC provides to learners and prospective learners, helping people make informed decisions about their development.

recognitions.title: Investors in People – Silver
recognitions.description: Investors in People – Silver reflects KBC's commitment to developing and supporting its people. It recognises organisational practice in leading, supporting and improving colleagues — a people standard, not a programme accreditation.

recognitions.title: APM Corporate Partner
recognitions.description: KBC's corporate partnership with the Association for Project Management supports our engagement with the project profession, recognised standards and relevant professional-development pathways. It does not mean every KBC programme is APM-accredited or every qualification is APM-awarded.

recognitions.title: CMI Approved Centre
recognitions.description: An approved-centre relationship with the Chartered Management Institute confirms KBC's status to deliver CMI-aligned leadership and management development, within the specific scope confirmed by CMI. It does not extend to programmes outside that approval.

recognitions.title: CIM Accredited Study Centre
recognitions.description: Accredited study-centre status with the Chartered Institute of Marketing reflects marketing programmes delivered in line with CIM's professional framework. This is distinct from KBC's CMI approval — CIM supports marketing, while CMI relates to management and leadership.

recognitions.title: Apprenticeship Provider of the Year – Finalist
recognitions.description: KBC was shortlisted as a finalist for Apprenticeship Provider of the Year. This finalist recognition reflects the quality, outcomes and employer feedback across our professional apprenticeship provision — a shortlist, not a win.

recognitions.title: Cyber Essentials Certified
recognitions.description: Cyber Essentials is a Government-backed certification confirming that KBC's systems and processes meet the required standard for cyber-security controls. It relates to organisational information-security practice — not to academic or programme accreditation.

recognitions.title: Living Wage Employer
recognitions.description: The Living Wage Employer recognition reflects KBC's commitment to paying colleagues the real Living Wage. It is an employer standard about how we value our people — it does not accredit programmes or learning.

benefits.title: For learners
benefits.copy: Quality support, professional standards and relevant progression relationships that strengthen the wider learning experience.

benefits.title: For employers
benefits.copy: Greater confidence in organisational standards, professional relationships, information security and workforce-development practice.

benefits.title: For professional development
benefits.copy: Connections with recognised bodies and standards that support relevant qualifications, professional practice and progression where applicable.
